a.xlink:title: Constructs and binds a Manager to a packet template.
Configures which validation groups are performed.
Returns mutable access to the owned primary Header.
Enables or disables automatic dependent-field finalization.
Finalizes dependent packet state without returning serialized bytes.
Computes an MSB-first 16-bit CRC over the supplied bytes.
Returns NORMAL, IDLE, or INVALID for the current header state.
Returns the configured mission-profile CRC trailer mode.
Returns the reserved trailer size: two bytes for CRC16, otherwise zero.
Finalizes the secondary header and serializes the complete data-field content.
Finalizes and serializes the packet under the v1.2 PDU profile.
Sets the encoded 16-bit Packet Data Length field.
Returns currently stored secondary-header bytes without finalizing.
Refreshes the installed secondary header once when it is dirty and updates are enabled.
